significantly.example_en: Her English has improved significantly this term.
significantly.example_zh: 这学期她的英语进步很大。

slowly.example_en: The bus moved slowly through the snow.
slowly.example_zh: 公交车在雪里开得很慢。

badly.example_en: She cut her finger badly while cooking.
badly.example_zh: 她做饭时手指伤得很重。

fully.example_en: I fully understand this grammar rule now.
fully.example_zh: 我现在完全明白这条语法规则了。

alike.example_en: The twin sisters look alike, so teachers often mix up their names.
alike.example_zh: 这对双胞胎姐妹长得很像，老师经常把她们的名字搞混。

locally.example_en: We try to buy vegetables that are grown locally.
locally.example_zh: 我们尽量买当地种的蔬菜。

safely.example_en: The children crossed the road safely.
safely.example_zh: 孩子们安全地过了马路。

specially.example_en: Mum baked this cake specially for Dad's birthday.
specially.example_zh: 妈妈专门为爸爸的生日烤了这个蛋糕。

largely.example_en: The plan worked largely because everyone helped.
largely.example_zh: 计划能成，主要是因为大家都帮了忙。

necessarily.example_en: A bigger bag is not necessarily better.

simply.example_en: I simply want a glass of water.

beautifully.example_en: She played the piano beautifully at the concert.
beautifully.example_zh: 她在音乐会上钢琴弹得很动听。

directly.example_en: This train goes directly to Shanghai.

quickly.example_en: Please reply quickly so we can book the tickets.
quickly.example_zh: 请尽快回复，我们好订票。

specifically.example_en: The teacher specifically asked us to bring a ruler.
specifically.example_zh: 老师特别要求我们带一把尺子。

unfortunately.example_en: Unfortunately, the library is closed today.

boldly.example_en: She boldly volunteered to speak first.
boldly.example_zh: 她大胆地主动要求第一个发言。

hopefully.example_en: She looked hopefully at the score on the screen.
hopefully.example_zh: 她满怀希望地看着屏幕上的分数。

strongly.example_en: The teacher strongly advised us to review tonight.
strongly.example_zh: 老师强烈建议我们今晚复习。

reasonably.example_en: The shop priced the pen reasonably.
reasonably.example_zh: 这家店给钢笔定的价格还算合理。

anxiously.example_en: She waited anxiously for the test result.
anxiously.example_zh: 她焦急地等待考试成绩。

widely.example_en: Football is widely played in our school.
widely.example_zh: 我们学校踢足球的人很多。

naturally.example_en: She talks naturally with new classmates.
naturally.example_zh: 她和新同学说话很自然。

perfectly.example_en: The cake fits in the box perfectly.
perfectly.example_zh: 蛋糕和盒子的大小正好合适。

somehow.example_en: Somehow the classroom door opened by itself.
somehow.example_zh: 不知怎么的，教室的门自己开了。

completely.example_zh: 我把作业忘得干干净净。

effectively.example_en: Pictures help students remember new words effectively.
effectively.example_zh: 图片能帮助学生有效记住生词。

truly.example_en: I truly believe you can pass this test.
truly.example_zh: 我真的相信你能通过这次考试。

equally.example_en: The two sisters are equally good at maths.

successfully.example_en: He successfully climbed to the top of the hill.

aloud.example_en: Please read the first paragraph aloud.
aloud.example_zh: 请把第一段大声读出来。

thoroughly.example_en: Wash your hands thoroughly before lunch.
thoroughly.example_zh: 午饭前把手彻底洗干净。

deeply.example_en: He was deeply moved by the story.
deeply.example_zh: 他被这个故事深深打动了。

frequently.example_en: It rains frequently here in spring.

accurately.example_en: Write the date accurately on the form.
accurately.example_zh: 在表格上把日期写准确。

easily.example_en: Beginners can use this app easily.
easily.example_zh: 初学者用这个应用很容易。

automatically.example_en: The lights turn on automatically after dark.
automatically.example_zh: 这些灯天黑后会自动打开。

considerably.example_en: The town has grown considerably in ten years.
considerably.example_zh: 这座小镇十年里扩大了不少。

constantly.example_en: My little brother constantly asks questions.

primarily.example_en: This book is primarily for middle-school students.
primarily.example_zh: 这本书主要是给中学生看的。

seriously.example_en: Please take the doctor's advice seriously.
seriously.example_zh: 请认真对待医生的建议。

rapidly.example_en: The river rose rapidly after the storm.
rapidly.example_zh: 暴风雨过后河水涨得很快。

bravely.example_en: She bravely told the teacher the truth.
bravely.example_zh: 她勇敢地把实情告诉了老师。

accidentally.example_en: I accidentally sent the message to the wrong classmate.
accidentally.example_zh: 我不小心把消息发给了别的同学。

totally.example_en: I totally forgot about the meeting.
totally.example_zh: 我把这次会面忘得一干二净。

definitely.example_en: We should definitely leave before six.
definitely.example_zh: 我们肯定得在六点前走。

certainly.example_en: I will certainly help you with the project.
certainly.example_zh: 我一定会帮你做这个项目。

oh.example_en: Oh! I left my keys in the classroom.
oh.example_zh: 哦！我把钥匙落在教室里了。

pardon.example_en: Pardon? Could you say that again?
pardon.example_zh: 请再说一遍？你能再说一次吗？

thanks.example_en: Thanks for lending me your pen.

hey.example_en: Hey! Your book is on the floor.

wow.example_en: Wow! You finished the puzzle so fast.

unless.example_en: You will miss the bus unless you leave now.
unless.example_zh: 你现在不走就会错过公交车。

whilst.example_en: Please stay quiet whilst the baby is sleeping.
whilst.example_zh: 宝宝睡觉时请保持安静。

wherever.example_zh: 你喜欢坐哪儿就坐哪儿。

plus.example_en: The ticket is twenty yuan, plus a small booking fee.
plus.example_zh: 票价二十元，另加一点订票费。

whatever.example_zh: 你喜欢哪个座位就选哪个。

ought.example_en: You ought to bring your book tomorrow.
